nodes.title: lPrompt
widgets_values:
段1:0-3秒
Live-action, cinematic, a medium-wide shot frames a young woman in a dark trench coat and short hair, holding a black umbrella, walking briskly along a rain-soaked city sidewalk at night. The camera is static. Steady rain taps on the umbrella, and her footsteps splash through shallow puddles. Her low breathing mixes with the rain. Non‑diegetic music: sparse piano notes at a very slow tempo begin.

段2:3-6秒
The camera cuts to a medium shot as she slows and stops beneath a dim yellow streetlamp. She tilts her head up to gaze at the glowing bulb; her breath forms white mist in the cold air. Rain softens under the lamp, and a distant traffic hum continues. The piano music continues with a single low cello drone joining softly.

段3:6-9秒
The shot cuts to a close-up,showing her pulling a smartphone out of her coat pocket with one hand.She glances down at the screen, brow furrowing. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the phone. The click of the phone case and a notification chime are heard. The piano and cello sustain a melancholic tone.

nodes.title: semantic_bridge_testPrompt
widgets_values:
Scene overview: A cinematic high-speed action scene on the rooftop of a moving train racing through a dense futuristic city at night. A young woman in a black leather jacket and dark cargo pants runs along the roof while being pursued by a masked attacker. Rain pours heavily, making the metal surface wet and reflective. Neon signs, illuminated windows and city lights streak past in the background.

Storyboard:
[0s-1.5s] The camera tracks backward directly in front of the woman as she sprints toward it along the narrow train roof. Her coat and hair whip violently in the wind. She briefly looks over her shoulder at the masked attacker running several meters behind her. Both characters maintain natural running anatomy and believable foot contact with the moving train.

[1.5s-3.2s] She reaches a low metal obstacle spanning part of the roof, plants her left foot and performs a fast running vault over it, supporting herself momentarily with her right hand. The camera swings dynamically from the front into a low three-quarter side angle while following the movement.

[3.2s-5s] She lands firmly on both feet and immediately continues running. Behind her, the attacker jumps over the same obstacle. At that exact moment the train passes beneath a shower of bright sparks from an overhead electrical structure. The sparks illuminate both figures for an instant while their reflections slide across the rain-covered metal roof.

Fast controlled camera movement, strong sense of forward momentum and physical weight. Realistic human anatomy throughout the running, vaulting and landing motions. Hands and limbs remain anatomically coherent. Accurate interaction between feet, hands and physical surfaces. Wet brushed metal shows sharp moving reflections, leather remains glossy but textured, fabric reacts naturally to wind and motion, rain catches the surrounding neon light. Strong depth and spatial continuity between the woman, attacker, train roof and rapidly moving city background. No slow motion.
